item.title: 183 North project Phase II: Northbound direct connector with MoPac to open Jan. 31
item.description: The northbound connector ramp between U.S. 183 express lanes and MoPac Expressway/Texas State Highway Loop 1 will open Saturday, January 31, according to officials with the 183 North Mobility Project.

item.title: Owner of massage parlor in Pflugerville faces sexual assault charge
item.description: The Pflugerville Police Department said a man was arrested Wednesday on charges related to a sexual assault that occurred in October 2025.

item.title: $100 more on your property tax bill? City of Austin produces draft bond recommendation
item.description: City of Austin staff released a 2026 bond draft recommendation last week, indicating what the city may be looking to prioritize in a potential ask of taxpayers later this year.

item.title: Austin businesses lock doors, shoppers swear off big box stores, in national ICE protest
item.description: Local businesses on Friday locked their doors, and shoppers swore off national chains and retailers as they put their money where their mouth is during a national shutdown.

item.title: ICE detainee in North Texas denied visitors abruptly amidst facility safety concerns
item.description: Leqaa Kordia has been held in ICE Prairieland Detention Center in Alvarado, Texas for over 10 months due to an expired student visa, with concerns raised about the conditions inside the facility, including lack of heat, clothing, and proper nutrition.

item.title: Catherine O'Hara remembered by Austin film, entertainment institutions
item.description: The sudden death of Catherine O'Hara on Friday shocked the TV and film industry, prompting countless social media tributes from co-stars, friends, and celebrities. Austin's film institutions have also shared posts honoring the actress.

item.description: Highs on Saturday will only be in the 40s, but won't feel any warmer than the 30s. -- Nick Bannin

item.title: LIVE BLOG: Austin demonstrators rally in protest of ICE Friday night
item.description: Protestors in downtown Austin gathered Friday evening as part of a nationwide movement protesting recent actions of ICE, or Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

item.title: Texas Governor calls for investigation into student-led protests against ICE
item.description: Texas Governor Greg Abbott said on Friday he is directing the Texas Education Commissioner to investigate student-led protest against immigration enforcement happening across the state.
